source.name: A Chain of Prayer Across the Ages: Forty Centuries of Prayer, 2000 B.C.–A.D. 1912
source.author: Selina Fitzherbert Fox (compiler)
source.publisher: John Murray, London; Bell and Cockburn, Toronto
source.note: Anthology arranged for daily use. In the US public domain (published 1913). Fox died 1958, so in life-plus-70 countries her own contributions are in copyright until the end of 2028; the older prayers she reprints are not hers.
